audio_script_it:
Buongiorno, benvenuti al Morning Briefing di Price Alert.

Il Nikkei ha chiuso in calo dell'0.75%, Shanghai in calo dell'0.32%. Questo suggerisce un'apertura debole per i mercati europei.

Nella seduta di ieri, l'S&P 500 ha chiuso in rialzo dell'1.05%, mentre il VIX è salito del 2.91%. Il Dollar Index ha guadagnato lo 0.06%. L'oro si mantiene sopra i 4735 dollari l'oncia, con un incremento dello 0.07%. Il prezzo del petrolio è sceso del 4.43% a 97.40 dollari al barile.

La situazione geopolitica rimane tesa, con possibili implicazioni per i mercati. L'inflazione nel Regno Unito è accelerata al 3.3% a marzo, spinta dai prezzi del petrolio.

Oggi si attendono dati macro importanti, tra cui il PIL QoQ USA, in uscita il 29 aprile. La BCE ha mantenuto i tassi di interesse invariati. La prossima riunione della BCE sarà cruciale per capire le prossime mosse in materia di politica monetaria.

audio_script_en:
Good morning, welcome to the Price Alert Morning Briefing.

Asian markets closed lower. The Nikkei dropped 0.75% to 59,140, while the Shanghai index fell 0.32% to 4,093.25. This weakness may weigh on European and US markets at the open.

In Western markets, the S&P 500 rose 1.05% to 7,137.90. The VIX increased 2.91% to 19.47. The Dollar Index edged up 0.06% to 98.65. Gold holds above $4,700/oz, up 0.07% to $4,735.90/oz. Oil prices declined sharply, with Brent down 4.43% to $97.40.

On the macro front, attention is on geopolitical tensions. The Iran war's impact on oil prices and global inflation is being closely watched. In the UK, inflation accelerated to 3.3% in March, driven by rising petrol prices. ECB's Christine Lagarde discussed the energy shock and its implications.

Let's pivot to the cryptocurrency markets. Bitcoin is trading at seventy-eight thousand dollars, with a minimal change of negative zero point zero two percent. The ETF daily net inflow is eleven point eight million dollars.

In the altcoin space, Ethereum is down one point nine four percent to two thousand three hundred forty-one dollars, Solana is down two point two two percent to eighty-five point eight three dollars, and Binance Coin is down zero point nine four percent to six hundred thirty-six point zero four dollars.

The Fear & Greed Index is at forty-six, classified as Fear. Overall, it's a mixed bag in the crypto markets today.

Thanks for tuning in and we'll see you tomorrow. Have a great day and goodbye from Price Alert.

articles.title: Implementing the digital euro project
articles.snippet: The European Central Bank (ECB) is working on a digital version of the euro, a project started back in 2020 that is coming closer to fruition as the enabling EU legislation progresses. The ECB has designed a digital equivalent of cash, aimed at complementing physical euros for day-to-day payments. Its approach may be compared and contrasted with the US Federal Reserve’s reluctance to introduce a digital dollar and with the People’s Bank of China’s definition of the digital yuan largely as a bank deposit. articles.title: A Formal Defense Pact in the Indo-Pacific Is the Wrong Answer
articles.snippet: The debate over how best to deter China in the western Pacific has reached a new level of ambition. Ely Ratner, a former senior defense official in the Biden administration, proposed a “Pacific Defense Pact” — a legally binding multilateral treaty among the United States, Japan, Australia, and the Philippines. This reflects serious concerns over China’s rise and its potential future use of force along the first island chain. The underlying diagnosis is sound: Existing U.S. alliances in the region lack an integrated command and control structure and the collective responsiveness required to credibly deter China in a high-intensity conflict. The post A Formal Defense Pact in the Indo-Pacific Is the Wrong Answer appeared first on War on the Rocks .
